evidence.frozen_inputs: Configuration, datasets, complete direction archive, validation evidence, code and preselected reading cases match their frozen hashes.
evidence.directions: All 109 unit vectors finite; first 85 unchanged; selected mean direction exactly reconstructed from saved training states and labels.
evidence.heldout_sources: 64 unique sources, balanced real labels, disjoint from training/validation and the old intervention/generation subsets.
evidence.test: 704 actual outputs: exact tokens, source, prompt, vector fingerprints and unchanged factual prefixes verified; semantic audit linked to exact outputs.
evidence.regression: 160 actual outputs: exact tokens, source, prompt, vector fingerprints and unchanged factual prefixes verified; semantic audit linked to exact outputs.
evidence.controls: Three random directions use identical perturbation norms, layers, phase masks and prompt profile to the selected controller.
evidence.qualitative_reading: All 12 preselected trios have assistant notes linked to their exact saved outputs; no independent human annotation claimed.
evidence.deliverables: Seven-page PDF contains exact demonstration outputs; HTML has all 64 trios without text changes; all 10 notebook code cells executed without errors; output hashes match.

limitations: Same base model is the semantic judge; no independent human ground truth.
Direction, layer, amplitude and intervention position change together relative to the original controller.
Explicit FACT/REVIEW format; no universal free-text control claim.
Unchanged factual prefix can still contain baseline summarization errors.
